findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_recalls" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the Recall Canary index of U.S. federal product recalls (FDA, FSIS, CPSC, NHTSA) by keyword, agency, severity, category, distribution state, hazard, firm…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
